extractionPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: one transparent 2-by-2 weapon sprite sheet for the existing Dawn Survivor diamond-obsidian-eclipse-valkyrie collection.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an intact original collection sheet. Extract and faithfully preserve ONLY its four standalone weapons from the right-hand portion. Remove the character, the background, all bottom projectile and impact illustrations. This is an asset repair, NOT a new design.
Rearrange the four COMPLETE weapons into equal quadrants of a landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG sheet: top-left revolver, top-right shotgun, bottom-left scoped crossbow, bottom-right flame cannon. One gun per cell, centered within that cell, pointed right as in the source. Fit the whole gun including stock, grip, barrel, trigger and all attached tassels/chains inside its cell with at least 8% clear padding on every side. Leave the horizontal and vertical middle gutters completely empty so the sheet can be mechanically sliced into four equal cells. Do not crop any part.
Preserve the original proportions, distinctive silhouettes, ornaments, material detailing, lighting and palette: black obsidian metal, silver thorn edging, restrained pink-magenta eclipse cores. Preserve ALL dark gun bodies and interior dark metal as fully opaque pixels. Only empty background and natural holes outside/between parts are transparent. No checkerboard drawing, no black/gray/white background, no rectangle behind weapons. Fine clean alpha edges, no glows masking holes, no text, no labels, no panels, no additional props, no restyling.
